title: Sample project: a day at the zoo
summary: An example of a day at the zoo for a group of children: a day out to see the animals, laugh and explore together.
story:
## Summary

A day at the zoo for a group of children: a day out to see the animals, laugh and explore together.

## The need

A day out for a whole group of children takes transport, extra helpers and a budget, so it does not happen often. These are exactly the days a child remembers.

## The plan

A full day at the zoo, where every child gets to see the elephants, the birds and the big cats, with transport, food and helpers arranged for the group.

## What it leaves behind

A happy memory for every child. After the day the story and the pictures are shared here, so that everyone who gave can see the smiles they created.
